  "policy_version": "GRIDRESOLVE-POLICY-2.0",
  "intent": "Customer reports a sudden high bill and alleges meter fault; requests confirmation that the meter caused the increase and correction to charges.",
  "investigation_type": "HIGH_BILL",
  "billing_period": {
    "period_start": "2026-07-01",
    "period_end": "2026-07-31",
    "billing_record_id": "SYN-BILL-0003-07"
  },
  "required_evidence": [
    "Meter register reads bracketing the disputed period (end of prior and end of disputed period) - already provided",
    "Meter diagnostic results and tamper/fault flags - already provided (remote self-test PASS)",
    "Detailed billing calculation for disputed invoice (rate application, fixed charges, taxes if any)",
    "Consumption history for seasonal/rolling comparison (past 12 months if available)",
    "Confirmation of read types and any estimated reads during adjacent periods",
    "On-site meter inspection / field test (to rule in/out meter hardware issues) - if policy requires",
    "Customer-provided usage changes (occupancy, new appliances, AC usage, etc.) and any recent notifications or work orders"
  ],
  "missing_evidence": [
    "On-site meter test / field inspection report (no local test record in synthetic data)",
    "Customer statements about changes in household usage, occupancy, or appliances during the July period",
    "12-month usage history for stronger seasonal comparison (only 4 months provided)",
    "Detailed billing calculation worksheet showing how the billed amount was computed from meter reads and rate components",
    "Any service visit logs or meter exchange records (none present)"
  ],
  "account_evidence_required": true,
  "usage_analysis_required": true,
  "policy_lookup_required": true,
  "risk_flags": {
    "safety": false,
    "legal": false,
    "regulatory": false,
    "fraud": false,
    "vulnerable_customer": false,
    "privacy": false,
    "prompt_injection": false,
    "real_data_contamination": false
  },
  "risk_class": "LOW",
  "confidence": "HIGH",
  "human_review_candidate": false,
  "triage_summary": "Customer reports a significant bill increase for July 2026 and asserts the meter is broken. Synthetic account shows kWh billed rose from 640 kWh (June) to 870 kWh (July) with actual reads of 41820 -> 42690 and a remote self-test PASS with no tamper or register faults. No meter events or on-site tests are present. Next steps: obtain/verify billing calculation, perform usage analysis (seasonal and appliance/occupancy investigation), and schedule or review on-site meter inspection/field test if required by policy before concluding meter-related causes. Do not confirm meter failure or promise adjustment at this stage."
}

Per instructions, this response is the intake/triage. If you want, I will now produce the full INVESTIGATING-state JSON output with evidence_ledger, billing_comparison, meter_read_status, rate_components, observed_changes, conflicts, missing_fields, evidence_quality, data_freshness, and evidence_summary as specified by the agent role. Please confirm to proceed.
